description: Use this when the user wants an admin pool or a management pool added to a class of one of their funds, funded by the fund or by its manager. Starts adding the pool. Returns Capital Company’s next question — the pool’s type, who funds it, how the manager pays, its amount or date — or the proposed pool for the user to confirm. This call creates nothing.

request.description: What the user asked for, in their own words

team.description: The team to act on, by name, only when the user belongs to more than one team; leave it out otherwise

timeZone.description: The user’s IANA time zone, such as America/New_York

name: capital_company_add_fee_pool
title: Add a fee pool
